pages.text: Metal blocks are decorative and storage blocks for various metals. They can be crafted from ingots and smelted back down.

pages.title: Silver Block
pages.text: Storage block for Silver Ingots with magical properties.

pages.title: Prismite Block
pages.text: Storage block for Prismite Ingots with refractive properties.

pages.title: Quantum Block
pages.text: Storage block for Quantum Ingots with quantum properties.
